description: The dial, in the style of a classic Portugieser, features a constant-force tourbillon together with displays for the 96-hour power reserve and sidereal time, which, among other things, is needed to find the same star each night in the same position.

name: Jaeger LeCoultre Master Ultra Thin Tourbillon
description: 40 mm - Pink Gold 750/1000 (18 carats) - Automatic winding. In an aperture at 6 o'clock, the Master Ultra Thin Tourbillon watch gives way to the spellbinding ballet of its tourbillon, enhanced by a row of diamonds that adorns and encircle its bezel. Designed to enhance the spectacle of the tourbillon and its new gold bridge, the setting of its 68 diamonds exemplify the talent of the master craftsmen who meticulously select each gemstone before working to bring out its shine and brilliance. Visible under its sapphire crystal, the case-back of the watch offers another, equally fascinating, spectacle: That of its mechanical self-winding movement, the Jaeger-LeCoultre Caliber 978G.
